page.layout: One page of text, single column; a title block at the top centred, then a dedication heading, then the body paragraph beginning with a woodcut initial. No margin notes. Signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Reverendissimo in Christo Patri ac Domino, WILHELMO, Divinâ Providentiâ, ARCHIEPISCOPO CANTUARIENSI, Totius Angliæ Primati ac Metropolitano.
Illustrissime Præsul,
main_text.p: QUOD Clementiæ Vestræ Opus istud nuncupare audeam, facit Usseriani Nominis dignitas; quæ ratione summi, quem in Ecclesiis Britannicis tenes, loci à te potissimùm Patrocinium quæreret; si tanto nomini quærendum esset. Ille quidem in cœlos jamdiu receptus, extra omnes invidiæ ictus collocatur;

page.notes: The opening word "QUOD" is set with a large initial Q in a woodcut frame of foliage; the initial is read as Q and the rest of the word as UOD. The printed signature "A 3" sits at the foot beside the last line. The faint text bleeding through the page (show-through) and the digitiser's watermark at lower right are not transcribed. The word "Illustrissime" and small-caps lines are rendered as printed.
